question: Six butterfly species never before recorded in India were recently discovered in which Indian state’s Siang Valley?
solution: The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • Six **butterfly species never before recorded in India** were discovered in the **Siang Valley of Arunachal Pradesh**. • The discovery was made during a **camera-trapping and biodiversity survey** conducted in the **Litin Community Conserved Area (CCA)** near Simong village in **Upper Siang district**. • The findings were published in the **Entomon Journal** and highlight an ecological link between **Tibet’s Yarlung Tsangpo** and **India’s Brahmaputra basin**. • This marks a major milestone in documenting the **Himalayan biodiversity** and community-led conservation efforts in Northeast India.
